title: XMTPNotifi
tagline: Linking XMTP and Notifi service to help users receive a web3 service notification on receiving an XMTP message
description: An attempt was made to link XMTP and Notifi. It currently shows an Notifi subscription card inside the XMTP chat fork. The end goal was to allow users to be subscribed to XMTP DMs on Notifi. The current state of the project allows users to subscribe to updates on a dAapp after signing in into the forked version of the XMTP chat.
how_its_made: It currently involved studying various aspects of XMTP and Notifi and then forking the xmtp-inbox-web repo and adding Notifi react components and then adding a XMTP subscription service. The next step would be to write a bridge to relay XMTP DMs to Notifi service so that it can forward arbitrary DMs. This would involve delegating read access to the bridge.
